name: fastapi
description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
one_liner: A free toolkit Python developers use to build the behind-the-scenes APIs that power apps and websites — the plumbing, not something an end customer ever sees directly.
buyer: Nobody buys this directly — it's a free, foundational developer tool. The real customer is a company that needs developers who already know it, or a service built on top of it.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes all client backend projects on FastAPI so engineers are interchangeable across projects and onboarding is fast.
A startup builds its AI product's API layer on FastAPI because of its speed and automatic documentation, cutting backend development time.
A SaaS company (FastAPI Cloud, one of the project's own sponsors) sells managed hosting specifically tuned for FastAPI apps.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting or deployment-as-a-service specifically optimized for FastAPI apps (a crowded space, but with existing demand).
Sell a paid course or template pack ('Production FastAPI in a day') bundling auth, Stripe billing, and deployment boilerplate most teams rebuild from scratch.

steal_this: Package a opinionated FastAPI starter kit (auth + billing + background jobs + deploy script) and sell it once to indie developers who don't want to wire up the boring parts themselves.
